name: ChargeChain SPKLU Revenue Token
description: CHRG is the platform's single asset-backed revenue-share coin — there are no per-SPKLU tokens. One coin represents a claim on the operating margin of a POOL containing only PLN's highest-utilization SPKLU EV-charging stations in Indonesia: the 54 stations (out of 329 in the network) with connector occupancy >= 70% (avg 92%), which alone generate ~69% of network transactions and ~73% of energy (actual operational data, March 2026). Pool energy ~19.79 GWh/yr; capitalization ~Rp 60.9 billion; 608,928 coins at Rp 100,000 par; target yield 13%. Optional future expansion (Regional · Latent Demand, 324 data-validated points) mints the same coin only when new stations are built and validated. Educational/simulation project — not an investment solicitation.
